assets.label: seal support coolers
assets.service: barrier-fluid cooling for the hydrocarbon transfer pump family

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: injury during a breakdown response on HX-4120

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on HX-4120 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. HX-4120 (seal support coolers) is in service for barrier-fluid cooling for the hydrocarbon transfer pump family. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 3 July 2026 an incident occurred on HX-4120 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
